approval.scope: Empirical reference and two absolute tolerances; unified release preparation.

notes: User-accepted empirical comparator from the completed original-grid reproduction. Both outputs must pass. No method/intermediate checks. Extra ungraded fields are ignored.
reference_method: Original-grid FE-start finite-duration half-height Tc*; five-strain OLS slope. Method is provenance, not an agent requirement.
limitations: Half-height estimates are empirical working proxies, not demonstrated equilibrium Curie temperatures.
Initial-state, duration, size and transition-diagnostic effects are not bounded by seed scatter.
Two held-out comparisons are retrospective; their existing protocol failures and >5-hour runtimes remain unchanged.
coverage_scope: Marginal normal-model prediction intervals, not mean confidence intervals, not established method-independent coverage, and not a joint 90% pass-rate claim.
